description: Poll the status of an image or video generation started by lab_generate/lab_animate. There is no single-item status endpoint on the backend — this fetches the project's full image/video list and filters by id, so it needs BOTH project_id and id (the id alone is not enough). status inside the returned item's metadata is 'pending'|'completed'|'failed'; when completed, image_url/video_url is populated. When the run is done, the answer may additionally carry schritte (the step trail of this run) and review (a machine check against the confirmed brief, present once for a run that went through lab_propose/lab_run_proposal — absent for a still-pending run, a run started outside a proposal, or a repeat poll after the one-time check already ran): abweichung lists every field that came back different from what was confirmed, possibly empty; tool means the provider fallback chain degraded the run; bild means a vision check found the result contradicting an explicit statement of the brief (free for the user, once per run; bild_review says why it was skipped). A failed or degraded proposal run may also carry plan_b: alternatives with checked prices and proposal IDs, offered once. Present them to the human; never start them yourself. Call lab_run_proposal only after the human confirms an alternative.For a run that carried a kamerapfad, metadata.kamerapfad says what arrived and, as `angewandt`, WHICH form of it was actually sent — als_text (prose), als_regiebefehle (bracketed director commands, MiniMax/Hailuo), eigene_regie (the prompt already carried bracketed commands, so the path was deliberately NOT added next to them — eigene_regiebefehle lists them) or nicht_ableitbar (nothing of the path reached the prompt, with the reason). `sprache` next to it names the family rule and the source it rests on. For a reference-motion run, metadata.referenz_masse is the reference trail: one row per reference with what it measured (original_px) and, if the backend had to scale it to the model's limits, what it became (angepasst_px) and the address that was actually sent. Look there when a result ignores a reference or looks softer than the source — a silently rescaled reference looks like a badly generated one.

id.description: The id returned by lab_generate (image) or lab_animate (video)

preview.description: Attach the image itself, downscaled to 512px, so it can be LOOKED at instead of described. Costs one extra fetch and adds roughly 15-25 KB to the answer. Videos carry no still and return no picture — that needs a contact sheet, which is not built yet. Without this flag the answer is unchanged.

project_id.description: Project id — required, since there is no global id lookup

type.description: Whether the id refers to a generated image or a generated video

wait_s.description: Wait up to this many seconds (max 80) until the result is rendered AND its prompt check (abgleich) is in, or it failed — instead of polling in quick succession. The answer says gewartet_s. tool_id is the catalog id even after tool_used switched to the display label.

name: lab_job_status
title: Generation Status
